title: Coin Change
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n, the number of coin denominations.
Line 2: n space-separated integers, the coin values.
Line 3: integer amount.
outputFormat: The fewest number of coins summing to amount, or -1 if it cannot be made.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 12
1 <= coins[i] <= 2^31 - 1
0 <= amount <= 10^4
You have an unlimited supply of each coin.

examples.explanation: An odd amount cannot be formed from 2-value coins.
